extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: grandfather clock (longcase clock) 0.56 x 0.33 x 2.08 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; dark wood case on bun feet, hood with turned columns, ivory dial with hour ticks only (no numerals, no text), dark hands, moon arch with a gold crescent and stars, arched crest with three gold finials. Movable parts: 'grandfather-clock_door' (origin on the vertical hinge axis at the left edge; rotate about local Z, negative angles open it towards the viewer's left), its glass pane 'grandfather-clock_door_glass' is parented to the door; 'grandfather-clock_pendulum' (origin at the suspension point; rotate about local Y, about +-8 degrees for the swing)

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
